_about: Client quotes and starting prices shown on service pages and their city pages. Only add quotes a client has approved in writing, word for word. A testimonial appears only when 'approved' is true and 'quote' is filled. A price appears only when filled. 'service' and price keys match data/services.json (e.g. whatsapp-chatbot, jewellery-marketing). Run python3 tools/build.py after editing.
